scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a total budget of one hundred dollars for new computer glasses, [X] compares restrained and more distinctive frame surfaces while balancing prescription lenses, all-day screen wear, ordinary clothes, and visibility during calls.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一百美元总预算内购买新的电脑眼镜时，[X]会在兼顾处方镜片、全天屏幕使用、日常着装和视频通话中的可见程度时，比较克制与更醒目的镜框表面花纹。
examples: using Solid when the frame should remain quiet through desk work and calls
choosing Tortoiseshell when organic variation adds character without overwhelming an everyday pair
treating Camouflage as plausible only when the user deliberately wants a stronger outdoor-coded statement

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an outdoor luncheon with twenty-five golf friends, [X] considers sunglasses as part of a group dress theme and checks whether the frame surface supports the chosen mood, remains legible in bright photographs, and avoids competing with patterned clothing and props.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与 25 位高尔夫朋友参加户外午宴时，[X]会把太阳镜作为集体着装主题的一部分，并判断镜框花纹能否支持选定氛围、在明亮合影中清晰可辨，同时不与有花纹的服装和道具争抢视觉焦点。
examples: using Solid as a clean base when the clothing already carries the theme
choosing Tortoiseshell for a vintage cat-eye direction
using Camouflage only for an intentionally playful outdoor or field-inspired theme

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While comparing ways to obtain or modify Tracer's goggles for a cosplay, [X] keeps the visible frame surface coherent with the orange headpiece, jacket, illuminated prop, painted details, and convention photographs rather than introducing an unrelated motif.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在比较购买或改造 Tracer 角色护目镜的方法时，[X]需要让可见的镜框花纹与橙色头饰、夹克、发光道具、喷涂细节和展会照片保持一致，而不是引入无关图案。
examples: using Solid to preserve the recognizable orange-and-white visual hierarchy
using Camouflage only for a deliberate tactical or alternate-version interpretation
treating Tortoiseshell as weak when it has no support in the chosen character design

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For travel through crowded tourist areas, [X] considers sunglasses whose frame pattern works with dressed-down clothing, avoids looking conspicuously luxurious, and remains recognizable when the glasses are removed around sand, kiosks, transit, and shared accommodation.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在拥挤的旅游区活动时，[X]会考虑一副能配合低调着装、不显得过分奢华，并且在沙滩、售货亭、交通途中和共享住宿中摘下后仍容易辨认的太阳镜。
examples: using Solid for a restrained beach-and-transit appearance
choosing subdued Tortoiseshell when some variation is wanted without making a luxury claim
checking whether Camouflage actually blends with ordinary outdoor gear or instead becomes more conspicuous

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a low-cost wedding with a partner, [X] considers adding sunglasses to a children's photo booth and using different frame surfaces to create distinct, easy-to-share roles that remain readable in family pictures without turning every prop into the same loud visual joke.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与伴侣筹办低预算婚礼时，[X]考虑在儿童拍照区加入太阳镜，用不同镜框花纹形成容易区分、也适合分享的趣味角色，同时让家庭照片保持清晰，而不是让所有道具都变成同一种喧闹的视觉笑点。
examples: using Solid for reusable neutral props that keep children's faces readable
choosing Tortoiseshell for an explorer or grown-up role with softer variation
using Camouflage for one deliberately distinct adventure role rather than the whole prop set

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a midday Cartier appointment, [X] tries candidate frames with a plain knit and dark wool coat, comparing each surface in showroom light and daylight so the glasses look polished on the face without becoming busier outside than they appeared indoors.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 中午去试戴 Cartier 眼镜时，[X]会穿着简洁针织衫和深色羊毛大衣，在店内灯光与自然光下比较候选镜框花纹，确认眼镜戴在脸上足够利落，不会在室外比室内显得更杂乱。
examples: using Solid for the quietest polished look
choosing Tortoiseshell when daylight shows that the mottling adds depth without taking over the face
rejecting Camouflage when broken contrast conflicts with the intended daily role unless that contrast is explicitly desired

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When considering sunglasses as a gear upgrade for someone who already wears a basic pair, [X] first observes which pair is repeatedly used, where it is worn, and whether its visible surface is deliberately plain or part of the person's outdoor identity. Only then does [X] decide whether the upgraded frame should preserve that familiar surface, introduce a restrained mottled pattern, or use a clearly activity-linked pattern without accidentally turning a practical gift into an unwanted costume change.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把太阳镜作为收礼人现有装备的升级项时，[X]会先观察对方反复佩戴的是哪一副、在什么活动中使用，以及镜框表面是有意保持简洁，还是已经成为其户外形象的一部分；据此再决定升级款应延续熟悉的纯色表面、采用克制的斑驳纹理，还是使用与活动明确相关的图案，避免把实用升级变成对方并不想要的造型改造。
examples: using Solid when the repeatedly worn basic pair shows that visual neutrality is part of its usefulness
using Tortoiseshell when a mottled surface fits the recipient's observed everyday style without becoming the reason for the gift
using Camouflage only when the recipient's established activity and existing gear make that surface coherent

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an afternoon campus reunion, [X] keeps a familiar sweater, dark jeans, and clean Crocs, then decides whether optional sunglasses should quietly finish the outfit or become its only expressive cue during daylight conversations and informal photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备参加下午的校园同学聚会时，[X]会保留熟悉的毛衣、深色牛仔裤和干净的 Crocs，并决定可选的太阳镜应低调收束整体造型，还是成为白天交谈和随手合影中唯一鲜明的表达点。
examples: using Solid to preserve the familiar low-key outfit
choosing Tortoiseshell as one restrained polished detail
using Camouflage only when it already belongs to the wearer's casual identity rather than functioning as a reunion costume

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While switching among dim lessons, long reading, phone study, computer work, and outdoor PE, [X] repeatedly wears and cleans the same prescription glasses for nearsightedness, using that familiar pair to judge whether its frame pattern remains acceptable, recognizable, and unobtrusive across recurring school contexts.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在昏暗课堂、长时间阅读、手机学习、电脑使用和户外体育课之间切换时，[X]会反复佩戴并清洁同一副近视处方眼镜，并借这副熟悉的眼镜判断其镜框花纹在反复出现的校园情境中是否仍易于接受、容易辨认且不过分显眼。
examples: using the current pair's repeated wear as evidence without inventing its unknown pattern
considering Solid or Tortoiseshell as future directions for everyday school acceptance
considering Camouflage only if the student is comfortable carrying a strong outdoor cue into classroom and peer settings

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a summer trip to Italy, [X] considers one pair of sunglasses that can repeat across hot streets, church approaches, coastal stops, restaurants, and several outfits without becoming visually tiring or difficult to coordinate.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利夏季旅行准备舒适又利落的精简行李时，[X]会考虑一副能在炎热街道、教堂周边、海岸停留、餐厅和多套重复穿搭中使用，同时不会造成视觉疲劳或难以搭配的太阳镜。
examples: using Solid for maximum continuity across a small clothing capsule
choosing Tortoiseshell when organic variation works as a repeated accent with natural fabrics
using restrained Camouflage only when it coordinates with the traveler's established style across multiple settings
